title: give the UI pass a hint-line width sweep that asserts the help hint keeps its scroll key wherever the help overflows

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-133013-979c, project ork, item S535:
